Overview 
 What our team offers
 The Cloud and AI Platforms Monetization (“CAPM”) organization is a big picture team at our core that encourages a diverse and inclusive culture. We are respectful, collaborative, honest, accountable, and caring. Employees on the team can expect to have opportunities to grow their own experience and career while shaping the future of the Azure business with data-informed strategies.
 We are growth strategists who monetize product value and improve the buying experience for customers to drive business growth and profitability for Microsoft. The CAPM team enables the Microsoft mission by creating durable profit growth through high-impact monetization strategies, packaging, and pricing.
 Enhancing our team culture and team experience is a top priority for our leadership, managers, and team more broadly. Our aspire-to team culture is one with cultural attributes encompassing transparency, growth and development, connection, and productivity and balance, all anchored on promoting diversity and inclusion.
 What I will do for you as your manager
 Champion your success with the team and with leadership.
 Give you the resources and support to succeed and grow your career as a business planner.
 Provide opportunities to gain new experiences and build on your strengths.
 Support who you are as your authentic self.
 Make your career development a consistent priority.
 Role Overview and how you can make an impact
 As the Business Planner, Azure Container Services and Developer Innovation , you will play a critical role in shaping how Microsoft monetizes and grows some of Azure’s most important container, developer, and emerging AI services.
 AI agents are moving from pilot to production, and they need a secure, scalable place to run. On Azure, that place is increasingly containers. This role puts you at the center of that shift: you will shape the business model for the container services that form the foundation for enterprise AI, and you will incubate new products from a blank page.
 Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) is Azure's managed Kubernetes platform, widely adopted by enterprises to run applications at scale, and it is increasingly central to how organizations run AI workloads. Together with Azure Container Instances (ACI), our serverless container service, it gives customers flexible and secure ways to run modern and AI applications on Azure. AKS Edge extends the same Kubernetes experience to edge and on-premises environments, supporting our hybrid strategy for enterprise customers.
 You will own planning, pricing, and packaging across AKS Edge, ACI, and Azure Red Hat OpenShift (ARO), a fully managed OpenShift application platform for enterprises modernizing on Kubernetes. The portfolio spans the edge, serverless, and enterprise modernization, giving you a broad portfolio with a clear role in how AI and traditional workloads run on Azure.
 You will also lead Azure App Testing, Microsoft's unified testing platform that brings Load Testing, Playwright Testing, and other testing services together under one brand, spanning performance and functional testing. It is a high-growth, developer-centric market, with the global software testing market projected to exceed $500B by 2033, and you will shape pricing, packaging, and adoption to position Azure as the go-to platform for AI and intelligent application quality. Alongside it, you will incubate early-stage, emerging products, where you define the business model from concept to launch and decide what to scale, pivot, or stop.
 In this role, you'll convert product roadmap into durable business outcomes by defining monetization strategy, shaping business models, and driving pricing and packaging decisions that deepen product-market fit. You'll contribute to simplifying the customer experience, designing adoption motions, and turning customer signals into clear business and commercial choices. Your work will shape how developers and enterprises adopt and scale AI applications and agents on Azure and in hybrid deployments.
 Our team is customer-focused and inclusive, values collaboration and data-driven problem solving, and works across partner teams to define and execute business models and monetization strategies that drive long-term growth. You will partner directly with engineering, product, finance, marketing, sales, and pricing operations, while running an established portfolio and building what comes next.
 If you thrive in strategic, cross-functional environments and want to shape both established container services and early-stage bets, this Business Planner, Azure Container Services and Developer Innovation role is a uniquely visible opportunity to define how modern and AI applications are built, tested, and run on Azure.
 Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 



 Responsibilities 
  
 As a Business Planner, Azure Container Services, Developer Innovation & Incubations , you can expect to learn from the following activities: 

 Lead and evolve the monetization strategy for Container Services such as Azure Red Hat OpenShift (ARO), Azure Container Instances (ACI), and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) Edge, including pricing, packaging, and revenue growth.

 Own the business model for Azure App Testing, from adoption and trial design to pricing and packaging. 

 
 Build business models for incubation products from concept to launch. 

 
 Bring a quantitative perspective to support your recommendations (i.e. bring data to bear). 

 
 Identify pricing and licensing optimization opportunities by interacting closely with partners, sellers, and customers. 

 
 Create business model proposals, present them to senior leadership, and drive cross-functional alignment. 

 
 Collaborate with pricing operations (i.e. Commerce and Ops) to implement business models and pricing. 

 
 Drive revenue growth and track portfolio health across container services and emerging products.

 


 Qualifications 
 Required/minimum qualifications
 Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Computer Science, Economics, Business, or related field AND 2+ years product management, strategy consulting, finance, business/corporate development, or related experience OR equivalent experience.
 
 
 Additional or preferred qualifications
 Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Computer Science, Economics, Business, or related field AND 5+ years product management, strategy consulting, finance, business/corporate development, or related experience OR Master's Degree in Business Administration (MBA), or related field AND 3+ years product management, strategy consulting, finance, business/corporate development, or related experience
 OR equivalent experience.
 
 Track record of working across diverse stakeholders to define and execute strategic initiatives with passion, precision, and excellence.
 Analytical problem-solving skills and ability to synthesize data from multiple sources to drive data-driven decisions.
 Sound business judgement leveraging strong strategic thinking complemented with a bias for action and execution/operational excellence.
 Great communication and leadership skills to drive projects and build executive buy-in and support for key projects.
 Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to build structure for early-stage products.
  
  
  


 

 Business Planning IC3 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $86,100 - $169,800 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $113,300 - $187,400 per year. 
 
 Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here:
 https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay 

 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

 
 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer.
